recognize_zh: 綠色箭頭指向染色質細緻、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞；紅色箭頭指向一個大型、胞質充滿粗大紫色顆粒而遮蔽核的異常顆粒球系細胞，加上周圍多個芽細胞與核異常的紅血球前驅細胞，呈現芽細胞增加合併多系發育不良。
features: Increased blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (green arrow)
Large abnormal granulated cell with coarse purple granules obscuring the nucleus (red arrow), suggesting dysplastic granulopoiesis
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours and megaloblastoid chromatin
Admixed small lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm (green arrow). A large cell with abundant coarse purple granules obscuring the nucleus (red arrow) represents an abnormally granulated myeloid cell, and several erythroid precursors show irregular nuclear contours and megaloblastoid chromatin. Blast percentage cannot be determined from a single field. In conjunction with ≥20% blasts and dysplasia in ≥50% of cells in at least two lineages, the findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes (multilineage dysplasia).

ddx.vs: APL cells are a predominant population of hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than scattered granulated cells among agranular blasts.
Distinguished by blast count: MDS-EB has <20% blasts in marrow and blood.

ddx.dx: AML with recurrent genetic abnormality (e.g., NPM1-mutated) with dysplasia
ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia alone does not qualify for AML-MRC when a defining NPM1 or biallelic CEBPA mutation is present, so molecular testing is required.
Morphology is similar; classification depends on a history of prior cytotoxic therapy.
